reading_notes: R47 spans the A3 physical pin 4 inverting-input line after R43 and the Y2 return. R45 and R46 join their respective lower and upper threshold nodes to Y2.

The page-14 parts list gives R45 and R46 as 5.6 kilohms each and R47 as 1.5 kilohms. R44 is a different 160-ohm resistor on page 9 in the A2 ramp-output divider, already assembled there as R613; no second R44 is drawn here.
R27 connects Y2 to the 0 V return and X2:4 carries Y2, as established by the earlier output-pair read.
